description.value: The target feels the spirit's unresolved dying moment. Critical Success no effect. Success 4d6 mental damage. Failure 8d6 mental damage. Critical Failure 16d6 mental damage. Heightened +2d6 every 2 levels. High cost, high payoff: this one always risks the Fraying Table, even on a clean cast.
